bug_report:
GCC fails to optimize (a >> 1) + (b >> 1) + ((a | b) & 1) to PAVGB/PAVGW (or equivalent instruction)
SSE2 PAVGB/PAVGW, NEON/SVE2 SRHADD/URHADD, AltiVec vavgsb/vavgsh/vavgsw/vavgub/vavguh/vavguw, and LSX/LASX vavgr is equivalent to the following expression for each lane of an integer vector:
(a >> 1) + (b >> 1) + ((a | b) & 1)

A snippet that shows that GCC fails to optimize the above expression down to PAVGB/PAVGW (or an equivalent instruction) where supported on the target can be found athttps://godbolt.org/z/4o6c5e1hj.
